name: voltage
vibe: a high-voltage storm on near-black: forking lightning bolts strike across the frame, a Tesla arc crackles between two electrodes, charged particles rise through a breathing accent glow, an oscilloscope trace sweeps the base and a plasma orb throws sparks; headlines snap in with an electric zap, the accent word is a charged conductor with a jagged high-voltage underline, and scenes cut on a lightning strike — raw, kinetic energy for tech launches, gaming, sports, music drops and bold announcements. One accent hue is the current, so it re-tints to any brand color.

assets.photoMod: electric lightning neon energy dark high contrast tech glow

music.query: high energy electronic synthwave driving bass aggressive

sfx.style: electric zaps, arcing crackles, capacitor charge whines and a thunderclap on each strike — punchy, high-voltage and tight to the cuts
